# 80s anime — Style Prompt

> Hand-painted cel animation from the golden age of Japanese home-video animation, played back as a late-80s videotape: a small flat-shaded hero with hard-edged shadows and coloured lines, sliding through airbrushed night plates full of backlit neon, drawn on twos, cut on the bar, with cream subtitles burned into the tape and scanlines over everything.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

Four layers, and the contrast between them is the look:

- **Background painting**: soft airbrushed gradients, glowing window grids, neon signs, wet asphalt; painted once, then only slid.
- **Cel** (the hero, props, vehicles): flat fills, a **hard** shadow crescent, a **hard** highlight, a **coloured** outline (a dark version of the fill, never pure black), a thin neon rim light on the edge facing the city. Animated on twos (12 fps), blinks on threes (8 fps).
- **Backlit light** (透過光): signs, lamps, title letters and tail lights glow *through* the frame: a light core, a coloured tube, a soft halo.
- **Playback**: videotape on a CRT: fine scanlines, darkened corners, subtitles that live on the tape.

If a frame looks like modern digital anime, one layer is missing. Not moe anime (round faces, giant irises, hatched blush), not vector clip-art (uniform black lines, gradients inside shapes), not a film-print pastiche (no gate weave or scratches: this is tape), not a smooth 60 fps motion-graphics piece.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Cel rendering** (one helper does all of it): fill, then the shape minus a copy of itself shifted toward the light (upper left) is filled with the shadow colour (a hard crescent on the lower right); the same shifted the other way gives a thin highlight; a 2-4 px offset copy in the neon colour gives the rim light; then the coloured outline (about 2.2 px at 1080p, 0.5x on extreme close-ups). Shapes are Catmull-Rom curves through a few points with optional sharp corners (hair tips, collar points).
- **The 80s head**: a cranium sphere and an egg-shaped jaw, eyes at the vertical middle of the head; almond eyes with a thick upper lash line that flicks outward plus three separate lashes, a tall layered iris (darkest band on top, dark upper half, main colour, bright crescent below), one large and one small highlight; nose = a shadow plane and one stroke; mouth a short set line. Hair = a dark back mass, a cap, overlapping locks with sharp uneven tips over a darker under-layer, a jagged "angel ring" highlight; brows drawn over the fringe so the emotion reads. Hair and scarf are ribbons driven by a travelling sine (4 drawings, swapped on twos).
- **Bodies** are tapered capsules (limbs), a tucked torso with a light jacket stripe, gloves and pads as small cels. Character colours come from a night colour model (lit, shadow, highlight and line set separately), not from a tint over the frame.
- **Plates**, painted once at half resolution (soft like tape): a street of facades with lit window grids, warm shop windows, striped awnings, dark sign boxes with neon tubes (the words are text over the plate), vertical signs; a mirrored, darkened copy of the plate as the wet road with ripple bands; a bay panorama with a far shore of tiny lights, searchlights, rooftops and an elevated road dotted with lamps.
- **Glow** replaces the source's bloom: canvas `shadowBlur` on neon and windows while painting, `text-shadow` on DOM neon, radial gradients for lamps. No live 3D: the canyon's walls and road are projected quads painted once (vanishing point 960, 470, focal 700), and only the neon panels ride on two transparent CSS 3D wall planes under one `perspective: 700px`; their wet-road reflections are small 2D streaks placed per frame, as in the source.
- **Tape and CRT**: 3 px scanlines at about 20% darkness, corners darkened by a wide radial gradient, no curved border.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the night: the top of every sky (mixed with `--malam` for the darkest), the bay, the floor. `--latar-2` is the violet middle of each gradient and the far facades; mixed with `--utama` it becomes the magenta horizon glow (`--senja`).
- `--utama` is the neon signal: the title tube and its halo, magenta signs, the canyon glow, the hero's scarf (the protagonist's one accent colour), the rim light, the band on the parking roof, the chat button. `--aksen` is the second neon (cyan signs, the top title line, the stripe on the skates).
- Text: the top title line in `--aksen-di-latar`, the time and the label above the price in `--utama-di-latar`, the tagline and CTA details in `--teks`, the button text in `--teks-di-utama`.
- Fixed in every brand: the chrome title (white sky, violet horizon, pink, gold) with its dark `--tepi` outline, the subtitle cream (`--krem`) and the second speaker's cyan (`--sian`) with a 9 px dark outline, yellow/orange/violet/green neon, window gold and blue, the tail-light red (`--merah`) of the light trails, and the hero's night colour model (skin, purple hair, blue jacket, lavender skates). With a pale brand the plates turn into a daylight colour model while the tape layers keep reading.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the titles as heavy italic: Archivo Black skewed -12°, 210 px for the main title, 140 px on the end card, 230 px for a price (the currency at half size), 64 px for the line above the title, 52-128 px for small glowing labels. The main title is three layers: a 0.12 em dark outline, a 0.045 em neon tube with halo, a chrome gradient fill.
- `--font-isi` carries everything on the tape and the signs: Oswald 500 at 54 px for subtitles (cream, 9 px dark outline, centred 96 px above the bottom), Oswald 700 at 40 px for the boxed speaker tag, 54 px tube lettering on shop signs, 124 px on the canyon signs, 40 px tagline with 12 px tracking, 48-50 px for CTA lines.
- Without brand fonts: a heavy italic or skewed grotesque for titles (Archivo Black, Poppins 800, Bebas Neue at 1.2x), a semi-condensed sans for subtitles (Oswald 500, Inter 600).

## 5. Motion quality

- **Limited animation**: characters on twos (a new drawing every 1/12 s, 4-drawing hair and scarf cycles), bob and shake on twos (a few px, from a hash of the frame), one blink = one closed-eye drawing held for one 8 fps frame (0.125 s). Camera, plates, light trails and rain move on ones.
- **Cuts on the bar**: the score's grid is 116 BPM, one bar = 2.069 s; the side tracking holds 2 bars, every other shot one bar. In 15 s: title 1.2 s, side 4.14 s, rear 2.07 s, close-up 2.07 s, insert 2.07 s, end card 3.45 s. Transitions are hard cuts.
- **Side tracking speeds**: facades 900 px/s, near poles 2550 px/s (2.6x, every 2600 px), the hero holds near x 900 with an 18 px sine drift. The street plate is 3200 px wide and loops.
- **Rear canyon**: vanishing point (960, 470), focal 700, camera height 1.6 units, the world slides at 26 units/s; 30 neon panels on the walls (one every 2.1 units, looping every 64), faded in from 55 to 35 units away, each with a reflection streak 1560/z px long; the hero sways ±0.035 rad and bobs on twos.
- **Close-up**: held; only hair moves; 34 neon streaks fly past at 2400-4800 px/s; ±2 px shake on twos.
- **Insert**: speed lines and spray change drawing every 1/12 s (3-drawing cycle); the hub turns 40 rad per drawing (strobing); the number rolls up in 12.5 steps, one per 1/12 s.
- **Flicker-on** for backlit text: opacity steps on twos, e.g. 0 → 1 → 0.3 → 1 → 0.6 → 1. Title push-in 1 → 1.045 over the shot. End-card pan 120 px and zoom 1 → 1.04 while the text holds still.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Backlit title card with a slow push-in | the start of a broadcast, a promise | a show opener, an event name, a class launch |
| Side tracking, 3-4 parallax layers | steady momentum through a place | a journey, a commute, progress through a program |
| Rear view into a pseudo-3D canyon | speed, pressure ahead | steps rushing at you, a countdown, a race |
| Held bust with streaks behind | resolve while moving fast | a testimonial, a decision, a promise |
| Insert on a spinning detail with speed lines | this object matters | a price, a product part, a key number |
| Extreme close-up on eyes | recognition | a choice, a vow |
| Slow pan across a painted wide shot | arrival, a held breath | the venue, the city, the end card |
| Radial speed lines and a one-beat freeze | the instant before impact | a launch, a leap, a goal |
| An earlier composition repainted | what changed | before/after, years later, day to night |

Framing: cels read against the painted plate; keep the band around y 950-1020 for subtitles; signs and text stay inside 120 px side margins.

## 7. Native moves

- **Small flat hero in a big painted world** (the side tracking past neon shopfronts). *Fits content like:* a skater on the way to a night class; a delivery rider for a late-night kitchen; a creator walking to a gig; a student cycling through a city of exams.
- **Backlit light**: title letters, signs and tail lights glowing through the frame. *Fits content like:* a show title; a shop's name sign; a festival of lanterns; a broadcast going on air.
- **Speed grammar**: looping plates, canyon panels, radial lines, a wheel insert with spray. *Fits content like:* steps of a training rushing past; a fast checkout; a sprint to a deadline; data flying between cities.
- **Stillness as drama**: a held close-up where only hair moves and one drawing blinks. *Fits content like:* a student's quote; a founder's promise; the moment before a result; a goodbye.
- **Tape on the screen**: subtitles burned into the tape, a second speaker in cyan with a boxed tag, scanlines. *Fits content like:* testimonials; an interview channel; found home video; a radio call-in.
- **Colour-model change** (one place, another hour). *Fits content like:* a shop by day and night; a farm through the seasons; a room before and after a renovation.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Performance**: paint plates, characters and rain once at load into images (half resolution, canvases sized to their content) and only move or swap them; never redraw canvases per frame. Swap hair drawings by visibility, move layers by transforms, and give every moving image `will-change: transform` (otherwise it repaints each frame). On moving 3D planes use no `box-shadow`, `box-reflect` or pseudo-element reflections: they multiply raster and overdraw; paint static surfaces flat instead. A blur filter applied while drawing many shapes costs seconds: draw first, blur one copy.
- **Fonts in canvas** silently fall back before the font loads: put every word (sign lettering, titles, subtitles) in the DOM, never in canvas.
- **Pink faces and white cels turning pink** under neon: keep the night colour model for skin and jackets, add neon only as a thin rim.
- **Thick rim light swallows thin shapes**: 2-5 px offsets only.
- **Moe or clip-art drift**: almond eyes with a flicked lash line, egg jaw, locks with sharp tips; coloured outlines, never uniform black.
- **Smooth motion breaks the era**: characters move only on twos; only camera and light move on ones.
- **Readable text**: titles carry their own dark outline, subtitles their own outline on the tape; words on the plain background use the `-di-latar` tokens.
- **Footage**: the look is drawn, not filmed; a user's photo or clip from `list_media` belongs inside a framed screen or TV in the painted world, not as the background.

## Measured from the references

The reference excerpt (12 s at 24 fps) cuts at 4.63, 6.71, 8.79 and 10.83 s: median shot 2.08 s (one bar), 20 cuts per minute, all hard cuts, dark in every shot. Palettes per shot are deep indigo and violet (#130b21, #2e183c, #1a1126) with pink-lilac highlights; the side tracking carries most motion energy, the end panorama the least.

# 80s anime: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.2, medium 2.1, long 4.1.

## hook

- en: backlit chrome title flickers on at 12 fps over a painted night skyline while the camera pushes in slowly
- id: judul krom bercahaya menyala tersendat 12 fps di atas siluet kota malam, kamera mendorong pelan

## problem

- en: held close-up of the hero, only hair and scarf moving; one closed-eye drawing, a worried line on the tape
- id: close-up tokoh yang ditahan, hanya rambut dan syal bergerak; kedip satu gambar, kalimat cemas di pita

## fact

- en: side tracking past neon shopfronts in parallax layers, the hero drawn on twos, a red light trail behind
- id: kamera menyamping melewati deretan toko neon berlapis, tokoh bergerak 12 fps, jejak lampu merah

## step

- en: rear view racing into a neon canyon; each step is a neon sign rushing toward the camera
- id: dari belakang melaju ke ngarai neon; tiap langkah sebuah papan neon yang melesat mendekat

## compare

- en: the same painted place in two colour models, night then dawn, hard cut on the bar
- id: tempat lukisan yang sama dalam dua warna suasana, malam lalu fajar, potong tepat di ketukan

## number

- en: wheel insert through a puddle, speed lines and spray; the chrome figure rolls up on twos
- id: sisipan roda menembus genangan, garis kecepatan dan cipratan; angka krom berguling 12 fps

## proof

- en: held bust close-up, hair fluttering, the quote on the tape in cyan with a boxed speaker tag
- id: close-up yang ditahan, rambut berkibar, kutipan di pita berwarna sian dengan label nama

## offer

- en: a backlit neon sign carrying the offer flickers on over the painted street
- id: papan neon bercahaya berisi penawaran menyala tersendat di atas jalan yang dilukis

## cta

- en: wide night panorama, a red light crossing the bridge; name and contact flicker on, held 2 s
- id: panorama malam, cahaya merah melintas jembatan; nama dan kontak menyala lalu diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: an earlier composition repainted in a new light, the chrome title glowing, held 2 s
- id: komposisi awal dilukis ulang dengan cahaya baru, judul krom bercahaya, diam 2 detik
